title: Formalising Linear Elliptic PDE Theory in Lean 4
summary: We formalise in Lean 4, on top of Mathlib, the solvability of the Dirichlet problem for second-order linear elliptic operators in divergence form. The machine-verified results, with no sorry in the development, include the Poincaré inequality, the existence of weak solutions by the Lax-Milgram theorem, Rellich-Kondrachov compactness, the Fredholm alternative, the spectral theorem, interior regularity estimates, and the Sobolev embedding theorem.
